title: Ornament Painting
seo_title: Free Kids Ornament Painting at McCoy's in Joplin, MO
description: Kids can decorate a wooden ornament for the tree at this free, family-friendly ornament painting event at McCoy's, and toys will be collected for the Holiday Toy Drive. It is free while supplies last, and no registration is required. It takes place December 5, 2026 (Time TBD) at all McCoy's locations, including 205 S McCoy Ave in Joplin, MO.
address: 205 S McCoy Ave, Joplin, MO 64801-3061, United States, Joplin, MO
